purpose: Determine whether extending the frozen GP01 elliptic parameter boundaries explores a distinct mechanism or only converges to the GP01-L equilibrium control.

definitions.zero_length_limit: L_g=0 implies gamma=gamma_E on the solved interior rows

theorem.collapse_limit: As rho_star,T_star,M go to infinity and L_g goes to zero, gamma_E goes to gamma_L and g_eff goes to g_b*nu_n(y).
theorem.monotonic_boundaries: At fixed source and exponents, increasing rho_star, T_star, or M moves the zero-length branch monotonically toward GP01-L.

empirical_boundary_evidence.interpretation: The observed boundary direction is the analytic collapse direction toward the GP01-L control, not evidence for a distinct large-parameter elliptic mechanism.

decision.next_empirical_path: Test an independently measured dynamical/history state with leave-one-object-out prediction; do not extend A_max/rho_star/T_star merely to approach GP01-L.
decision.next_theory_path: Complete a causal source-history or route-independent persistence state whose finite-memory limit is not prediction-equivalent to GP01-L.

establishes: the exact zero-length boundary-collapse relation between GP01 elliptic and GP01-L
that extending the observed winning boundary direction cannot create a distinct asymptotic law
that dynamic and finite-memory descendants remain separate active hypotheses
does_not_establish: that every finite-length GP01 field is equivalent to GP01-L
that every environmental or history extension fails
a causal action or observationally preferred theory
